reason: The cited evidence discusses precipitation strengthening in other HEAs (e.g., CoCrFeNiTix, ZrNbTaHf0.2Crx) but provides no data on TiVNbTa specifically, nor on precipitate stability or strengthening at 1273 K in this alloy. The key premises about precipitate formation, thermal stability, and strength enhancement in TiVNbTa are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: TiVNbTa can form nanoscale intermetallic precipitates upon aging at 900–1000 K
Such precipitates are thermally stable and remain dispersed at 1273 K
Nanoscale precipitates impede dislocation motion (climb and glide) at 1273 K
Precipitation strengthening can raise yield strength at 1273 K from ~330 MPa to >500 MPa
